name: Alder
title: Forester
examine: Born here, which makes him the rarity. The copse was his mother's, and he can tell you the planting year of every trunk in it.
lines: Take the marked ones. The stand knows which it can spare.
That big oak by the hut went in the year I was born. We're neither of us done growing.
An axe wants a whole swing. Half swings are how handles break and knees meet mud.
